description.value: You have an exemplary understanding of body language. You gain the Sign Language feat, even if you aren’t trained in Society. In addition to signing, you can communicate with your body language with people familiar to you quite readily and they are able to understand you, such as a party you are traveling with or family members. In which case, communicating in this way uses the Visual trait instead of Auditory or Linguistic if it purely uses inaudible body language, or just Auditory if it requires sounds made by movements. Anyone you communicate with can eventually pick up on these cues if you choose to after spending at least a day of downtime with you.
